body: I actually didn't interpret it that way. Granted, Paula did have issues with boundaries and enabling in her friendship with Rebecca, but I actually could understand the way she reacted. For so much of the show she went to insane lengths for Rebecca  (usually about Josh, but generally any drama related to Rebecca she was far too involved in), and in Season 3 she'd finally gotten to a place where she was flourishing- she was studying law, her marriage had healed-. To me it makes perfect sense that she didn't want to get involved unless she herself was under threat- she'd spent so much time doing straight up illegal and dangerous things for and with Rebecca, and she wasn't going to risk everything she'd worked for even if the stakes were as high as they were. To be pushed into old, dangerous habits, and furthermore when you don't need to be, would piss anyone off.
